_comment: Targeted text fixes (27 Oct 2026, decision D-A): only the wrong phrase is replaced, the rest of the text stays byte for byte. Each edit is applied by apply_targeted_edits.py only if (a) the whole text then passes the full rule set, (b) it has no finding the original did not have; (c) the whole text was read again by hand. No LLM call. The edited records carry 'edited: targeted fix' in the trace.

edits.old: The lead change raises the stakes
edits.new: Taking the lead raises the stakes
edits.reason: at 2-2 there was no leader to change: the penalty takes the lead (goal_effect 'takes the lead'); shown in the demo video at 49'

edits.old: Vallora’s win propelled them to 12 points and the top of the standings, relegating Northbridge
edits.new: Vallora rose with the win to 12 points and the top of the standings, pushing Northbridge
edits.reason: dangling modifier ('Entering the final matchday ..., Vallora’s win' - the win did not enter the matchday) and 'relegating' (a football term for dropping a division)

edits.old: scoring a long-range right-foot strike
edits.reason: the 27' shot was taken inside the box near the byline (event at x 99, y 78.8; 19.6 m from the centre of the goal because of the tight angle): not long-range

edits.old: The halftime drama continued
edits.reason: British spelling as in the rest of the text ('equalising', 'equaliser'): 'half-time'

edits.old: but could not break down Vallora’s resilient defense.
edits.new: but did not score after the break.
edits.reason: Northbridge scored twice (2', 45+3'); after the break they did not score

edits.old: Vallora maintained a slightly higher pass accuracy
edits.new: Vallora maintained a higher pass accuracy
edits.reason: 79.57 % vs 72.47 % is a gap of 7.1 points, not 'slightly'

edits.old: underpinning their control at key moments
edits.reason: control words need a 58 % field tilt (Vallora 55.3 % over the match); pass accuracy and duels are match totals, not figures 'at key moments'

edits.old: The match settled into a balanced but intense regime with frequent momentum swings, particularly after the 49th-minute goal.
edits.new: The match was mostly in a balanced but intense regime, with several momentum swings.
edits.reason: after the 49' goal the regime was chaos from 56' to 70' (balanced 52'-55' and from 71'), so it did not 'settle'; Vallora's momentum changed sign 5 times (18', 39', 51', 78', 89'), not 'particularly after' 49'; most minutes were balanced

edits.old: Vallora utilized effective progressive passing
edits.reason: British spelling elsewhere ('Equalising', 'equalised', 'equaliser'): 'utilized' mixes American spelling in

edits.old: who made eight touches in the box to sustain
edits.new: who had made eight touches in the box by 41' to sustain
edits.reason: 8 touches in the box is Andreou's count at 41' (player_threshold moment), not his match total (10)

edits.old: goal equalizes with a precise header
edits.new: goal equalises with a precise header
edits.reason: British spelling as in the rest of the text ('Equalising', 'equalised', and 'equaliser' in the same line)

edits.old: Vallora’s territorial dominance fostered
edits.reason: control / dominance words need a 58 % field tilt (55.3 %); 'territorial advantage' needs more than 50 % (the text uses it in its last paragraph too)

edits.old: overturning the pre-match leaderboard by demonstrating superior control in critical phases.
edits.reason: 'superior control' at a 55.3 % field tilt is not backed by the facts

edits.old: lőtt a jobblábbal,
edits.reason: needless article; 'jobb lábbal' is two words (like 'bal kézzel')

edits.old: jobblábas lövéssel visszavette a vezetést Vallorának
edits.new: jobblábas lövéssel előnybe juttatta a Vallorát
edits.reason: Vallora had not led before 27' (0-1, 1-1): the goal takes the lead, it does not take it back; 'előnybe juttatta' avoids repeating 'megszerezte a vezetést' of the sentence before

edits.old: jobb lábas lövése veszi kezdetét a rangadó
edits.new: jobblábas lövésével veszi kezdetét a rangadó
edits.reason: ungrammatical (two subjects for 'veszi kezdetét'); 'jobblábas' as the text writes it in its first paragraph (like 'balkezes')

edits.old: kiegyenlít, elsöprő területi fölényben lévő Vallora
edits.new: kiegyenlít, a területi fölényben lévő Vallora
edits.reason: 'elsöprő' (overwhelming) overstates a 15-minute field tilt of 64.5 % at 18'; a proper name with a participle modifier takes the article ('a ... lévő Vallora')

edits.old: visszaállítja a Vallora vezetést
edits.reason: missing possessive ending

edits.old: Vallora United uralta kicsit a területi fölényt (55%)
edits.new: Vallora United enyhe területi fölényben játszott (55%)
edits.reason: control / dominance words ('uralta') need a 58 % field tilt; 55 % is a slight field tilt

edits.old: Vallora 2,35-szörös várható gólértékkel
edits.reason: 2,35 is Vallora's xG itself, not a ratio (the ratio is 1,85)

edits.old: Ekkor még észlelhető volt a Northbridge enyhe térfélfölénye
edits.new: Ekkor még észlelhető volt a Northbridge térfélfölénye
edits.reason: before 3' all four on-ball events in the final third were Northbridge's (field tilt 100 %): not 'enyhe' (slight)

edits.old: lövéssel újra vezetéshez juttatta Vallorát
edits.reason: Vallora had not led before 27': not 'again'

edits.old: miközben a térfélfölény és a területi fölény is a csapatnál volt.
edits.new: miközben a területi fölény is a csapatnál volt.
edits.reason: 'térfélfölény' and 'területi fölény' name the same measure (field tilt) twice; the claim holds (65.5 % in the 15 minutes before 27')

edits.old: így 2-2 volt az állás. Ebben a szakaszban magas volt a játék intenzitása és a párharcok száma is.
edits.reason: not backed: from 40' to half-time the duel rate (1.8 per minute) was below the match rate (2.1), and at the end of the half both teams' 5-minute pressing intensity (0.2 and 0.4) was the lowest of the match

edits.old: büntetőből szerzett góllal növelte előnyét:
edits.new: büntetőből szerzett góllal ismét vezetéshez jutott:
edits.reason: at 2-2 there was no lead to extend; Vallora had led 2-1 before, so 'ismét' (again) is right

edits.old: egy 12 méteres 89 km/h-s lövéssel
edits.reason: coordinate adjectives take a comma, as the text writes it at 2' ('98 km/h-s, 10,6 méterről leadott')

edits.old: Vallora megtartotta birtoklási fölényét és területi dominanciáját,
edits.reason: 'területi dominancia' at a 55.3 % field tilt (and only 26-56 % between 60' and 75') is not backed by the facts

edits.old: megőrizve 3-2-es győzelmét.
edits.reason: a team keeps a lead, not a win, during the match

edits.old: szerezte meg első tornagyőztes gólját
edits.new: szerezte meg első gólját a tornán
edits.reason: Nagy's 18' goal was his first tournament goal; the tournament-winning goal was the 49' penalty

edits.old: Vallora 51,9%, enyhe fölény a kritikus pillanatokban.
edits.reason: 51,9 % is the match possession; at the goals of 18' and 27' Vallora had 49,2 % and 49,3 %, so 'a kritikus pillanatokban' is not backed

edits.old: a támadóharmadban, jelentős dominancia.
edits.reason: 55,3 % vs 44,7 % is no 'significant dominance'; the bullet now gives both shares like the duels bullet

edits.old: de Vallora hatékonyabb támadáskihasználással.
edits.reason: Vallora scored 3 goals from 2,35 xG and Northbridge 2 from 1,27, so 'more efficient' is not backed; Vallora had 16 shots to 8 and the higher xG; the verbless form keeps the sentence parallel with 'Northbridge nagyobb letámadási mennyiséggel'

edits.old: ami a kontroll megtartásában kulcsfontosságú volt.
edits.reason: 'kontroll' is a control word without the field tilt; the pass accuracy speaks about keeping the ball

edits.old: Vallora 54% nyert, Northbridge 45%.
edits.reason: the object needs its accusative ending ('54%-ot')

edits.old: A match egészében a kontroll index kiegyenlített volt,
edits.new: A mérkőzés egészében a kontrollindex kiegyenlített volt,
edits.reason: English 'match' and the term 'kontroll index' in a Hungarian text (glossary: kontrollindex)

edits.old: hatékonyabb támadójátékról és magasabb passzpontosságról szólt a döntő pillanatokban.
edits.new: veszélyesebb támadójátékról és magasabb passzpontosságról szólt.
edits.reason: 'more efficient' is not backed (3 goals from 2,35 xG against 2 from 1,27); 'more dangerous' is (xG 2,35 vs 1,27, 16 shots to 8); the pass accuracy is a match total (at 2' Northbridge passed better), not a figure of the decisive moments

edits.old: tudott élni a lehetőségekkel, kontrollálta a játékot és így
edits.new: tudott élni a lehetőségekkel, és így
edits.reason: 'kontrollálta a játékot' at a 55.3 % field tilt is not backed by the facts
